preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdin.split() if x.isdigit())
preconditions.description: All integers in input are between 1 and n (inclusive), where n is the first integer in the test case.
The first line contains exactly one integer (t), followed by t test cases, each with n+1 integers (n followed by n permutation elements).

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(p)) == n for p in [list(map(int, line.split()[1:])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if len(p) == n)
preconditions.description: Each permutation p is a list of n distinct integers from 1 to n.
The length of the permutation n is at least 2.

postconditions.expression: all(len(p_prime) == n for p_prime in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a permutation p' of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(p_prime != p for p, p_prime in zip([list(map(int, line.split()[1:])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output permutation p' is different from the input permutation p.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted([p[i] + p[i+1] for i in range(n-1)]) == sorted([p_prime[i] + p_prime[i+1] for i in range(n-1)]) for p, p_prime in zip([list(map(int, line.split()[1:])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the sorted list of adjacent sums in p' matches the sorted list of adjacent sums in p (i.e., F(p') = F(p)).
